scenes.title: Controlled tank loop
scenes.description: One pump transfers water from A to B. A native level controller adjusts pump speed; a pipe and valve provide the return path.

nodes.label: Tank A
nodes.description: Open storage tank. The pressure shown is its bottom-port absolute pressure.

nodes.label: Pump
nodes.description: Native pump moves fluid through the supply pipe. Its speed follows the Modelica controller.

nodes.label: Tank B
nodes.description: Controlled open tank. The dashed amber line marks its recorded target level.

nodes.label: Valve
nodes.description: Return-path restriction. Opening and signed flow are native simulation results.

scenes.metricNotes: The closed network conserves stored mass. The residual measures the maximum absolute change from the initial stored mass. Pump energy is the native integrated signed shaft power over this finite run.

scenes.title: Restricted return valve
scenes.description: The return valve is more restricted. Compare native flow, pressure, and control response using the same tank-loop composition.
